        hidden_effect = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 27 } trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90 }
        ai_chance = { base = 45 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_cmp.23.b
        custom_tooltip = oe_cmp.23.b.tt
        hidden_effect = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 28 } trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90 }
        ai_chance = { base = 35 }
    }
    option = {
        name = oe_cmp.23.c
        trigger = {
            var:oe_cmp_holder ?= 3
            OR = {
                AND = { var:oe_cmp_partner ?= 1 country_exists = c:GEN }
                AND = { var:oe_cmp_partner ?= 2 country_exists = c:VEN }
            }
        }
        custom_tooltip = oe_cmp.23.c.tt
        hidden_effect = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_job value = 29 } trigger_event_silently = oe_cmp.90 }
        ai_chance = { base = 20 }
    }
}

oe_cmp.24 = { # 商社散伙
    type = country_event
    outcome = neutral
    image = "gfx/interface/illustrations/institutions/legalism.dds"
    title = oe_cmp.24.t
    desc = {
        first_valid = {
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end_test } desc = oe_cmp.24.d1 }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { NOT = { owns = location:constantinople } } desc = oe_cmp.24.d2 }
            triggered_desc = { trigger = { always = yes } desc = oe_cmp.24.d3 }
        }
    }
    trigger = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no var:oe_cmp_end ?= 3 }
    immediate = { oe_ml_take_as = { line = 30 } }
    option = {
        name = oe_cmp.24.a
        custom_tooltip = oe_cmp.24.a.tt
        ai_chance = { base = 100 }
    }
}

# (hidden) The Roman Company (worker). The jobs (BYZ var oe_cmp_job):
#   1 .1: the charter by oe_cmp_pick (1 the crown, 2 the merchants, 3 Genoa, 4 Venice; 0 not now). 1 without the gold any more: failure code 1, asked again after 12 months. 3 or 4 whose partner no longer qualifies: failure code 2, the merchants' charter instead.
#   2 the action oe_cmp_invest.
#   3 the action oe_cmp_audit.
#   5 .2 b: this year's dividend D goes back from the treasury into the fund (charter a: the net profit, = D); b, c: autonomy + 5, the holder pleased.
#   6 .2 c: the treasury's share + 10 (cap 20 above the charter's value), autonomy -5, the holder displeased.
#   7 .3 a, b: the customs are farmed out (oe_cmp_pick = the years: 20 or 10): the modifier oe_cmp_customs_farmed, the company's gross + 2 months a year meanwhile (oe_cmp_farm), autonomy + 10 or + 5.
#   8 .3 c: refused: 1 authority, autonomy -10, the holder displeased.
#   11 oe_cmp.12, sold: the land changes hands (oe_cmp_take_land); on success oe_cmp_sold, else the price goes back to the fund. A target that no longer fits: failure code 15, the price back.
#   12 oe_cmp.12, a street or the quarter: the post there becomes level 2 (the colonisation line's oe_col_post_fortify). Kind 2 (the quarter): the owner takes the price; a named grant also its opinion and the grant's mark. Kind 1 ('only a street', at the neighbouring site): the owner takes half, half goes back to the fund. A post that no longer fits: failure code 15, the price back.
#   13 oe_cmp.12, refused or unanswered (answer 3, 5, 6): 50 % of the price back to the fund (land and quarter); the other side is not asked again for 5 years (a player) or 2 (an AI); no answer: failure code 14.
#   14 oe_cmp.12, protection signed: the ruler is marked (country variable oe_cmp_prot = the month), thinks better of us (oe_cmp_op_protected) and is paid the first year's fee from the fund. No longer fit, or the fund cannot pay: failure code 15.
#   15 .14 a: the Company's own sailings: oe_cmp_own_convoys for 10 years.
#   16 .14 b: with the Italians' convoys: the partner (charter c), else Venice, else Genoa thinks better of us.
#   17 the action oe_cmp_buy: the location the action chose (BYZ var oe_cmp_pick_loc) is asked for, if it still fits.
#   18 the action oe_cmp_protect: the ruler the action chose (BYZ var oe_cmp_pick_who) is offered protection, if it still fits.
#   21 .21 a (the protected ruler chose it): it becomes the empire's tributary through phase 2's oe_cmp_make_tributary (switch TRIB, self-check, failure code 13; the treaty ends there).
#   22 .20 a: autonomy + 5, the treasury's share -5 (nothing once the Company has ended).
#   23 .20 b: 3 authority, autonomy -20 (nothing once the Company has ended).
#   24 .20 c: the fund fits out ships for the empire (4 months of income); the treasury gets 1 month as ship money; autonomy -10. A fund too small: failure code 22, nothing paid.
#   25 .22 a: the mahona's shares - Chios changes hands first (oe_cmp_take_land: switch LAND_FORM, failure code 11); then the owner is paid 20 months from the fund and thinks worse of us (and Genoa too, when it is not the owner), Genoa's privileges rise one tier as compensation (oe_itp_shift), a truce of 5 years (oe_cmp_truce), the island marked as bought and made a colonia (oe_col_found_colonia, the Company's mark). Chios no longer fit or the fund short: failure code 21, nothing paid.
#   26 .22 b: the yearly tribute only - the owner is paid 8 months from the fund; the treasury takes 1 month every January for 20 years while Chios stays on Genoa's side. Chios no longer fit or the fund short: failure code 21, nothing paid.
#   27 the action oe_cmp_nationalise and .23 a: oe_cmp_do_nat, if the treasury still holds half the fund (else failure code 23).
#   28 .23 b: the treasury's share -10, autonomy -30 (nothing once the Company has ended).
#   29 .23 c (charter c only): handed to the partner - its privileges rise one tier (oe_itp_shift, while D1 keeps its books), the treasury's share fixed at 20 % (share and its cap), autonomy no longer counted; oe_cmp_end 2. The books still run.
oe_cmp.90 = {
    type = country_event
    title = empty_text
    hidden = yes
    trigger = { tag = BYZ is_rebel_country = no has_variable = oe_cmp_job }
    immediate = {
        if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 1 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_cmp_pick ?= 1 }
                if = {
                    limit = { gold >= oe_cmp_need_a }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_amt value = oe_cmp_cap_a }
                    add_gold = { value = scope:oe_cmp_amt multiply = -1 }
                    oe_cmp_set_holder = { h = 1 cap = scope:oe_cmp_amt share = 100 auto = 0 }
                    add_estate_satisfaction = {
                        type = estate_type:burghers_estate
                        value = estate_satisfaction_weak_penalty
                    }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_c1_cd months = 12 }
                    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_c1_m } remove_variable = oe_cmp_c1_m }
                }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { OR = { var:oe_cmp_pick ?= 3 var:oe_cmp_pick ?= 4 } }
                if = {
                    limit = {
                        OR = {
                            AND = { var:oe_cmp_pick ?= 3 oe_cmp_ok_gen = yes }
                            AND = { var:oe_cmp_pick ?= 4 oe_cmp_ok_ven = yes }
                        }
                    }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_amt value = oe_cmp_cap_c }
                    oe_cmp_set_holder = { h = 3 cap = scope:oe_cmp_amt share = 40 auto = 10 }
                    if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_pick ?= 3 } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_partner value = 1 } }
                    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_partner value = 2 } }
                    oe_cmp_partner_op = { m = oe_cmp_op_partner }
                }
                else = {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 2 }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_amt value = oe_cmp_cap_b }
                    oe_cmp_set_holder = { h = 2 cap = scope:oe_cmp_amt share = 50 auto = 0 }
                    add_estate_satisfaction = {
                        type = estate_type:burghers_estate
                        value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus
                    }
                }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { var:oe_cmp_pick ?= 2 }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_amt value = oe_cmp_cap_b }
                oe_cmp_set_holder = { h = 2 cap = scope:oe_cmp_amt share = 50 auto = 0 }
                add_estate_satisfaction = {
                    type = estate_type:burghers_estate
                    value = estate_satisfaction_weak_bonus
                }
            }
            else = {
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_c1_no } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_c1_no value = 0 }
                }
                change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_c1_no add = 1 }
                if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_c1_no >= 2 } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fired_1 value = 2 } }
                else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_c1_cd years = 10 } }
                if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_c1_m } remove_variable = oe_cmp_c1_m }
            }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_pick } remove_variable = oe_cmp_pick }
        }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 2 } oe_cmp_do_invest = yes }
        else_if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 3 } oe_cmp_do_audit = yes }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 5 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_d var:oe_cmp_d > 0 }
                add_gold = { value = var:oe_cmp_d multiply = -1 }
                change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = var:oe_cmp_d }
            }
            oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = 5 }
            oe_cmp_mood = { up = yes pu = oe_cmp_op_reinvest pd = oe_cmp_op_squeeze }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 6 }
            oe_cmp_share_add = { n = 10 }
            oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = -5 }
            oe_cmp_mood = { up = no pu = oe_cmp_op_reinvest pd = oe_cmp_op_squeeze }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 7 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_cmp_pick ?= 20 }
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cmp_customs_farmed years = 20 mode = replace }
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_farm years = 20 }
                oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = 10 }
            }
            else = {
                add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cmp_customs_farmed years = 10 mode = replace }
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_farm years = 10 }
                oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = 5 }
            }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_pick } remove_variable = oe_cmp_pick }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 8 }
            international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -1 }
                clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
            }
            oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = -10 }
            oe_cmp_mood = { up = no pu = oe_cmp_op_reinvest pd = oe_cmp_op_squeeze }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 11 }
            var:oe_cmp_req_loc ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_land }
            var:oe_cmp_req_who ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_seller }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    exists = scope:oe_cmp_land
                    exists = scope:oe_cmp_seller
                    scope:oe_cmp_land = { owner ?= scope:oe_cmp_seller oe_cmp_land_fit = yes }
                }
                oe_cmp_take_land = yes
                if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_took ?= 1 } oe_cmp_sold = yes }
                else = {
                    if = {
                        limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_paid }
                        change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = var:oe_cmp_req_paid }
                    }
                }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 15 }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_paid }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = var:oe_cmp_req_paid }
                }
            }
            oe_cmp_req_clear = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 12 }
            var:oe_cmp_req_loc ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_land }
            var:oe_cmp_req_who ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_seller }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_req_kind ?= 2 } scope:oe_cmp_land ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_street } }
            else = { var:oe_cmp_req_site ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_street } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    exists = scope:oe_cmp_street
                    exists = scope:oe_cmp_seller
                    scope:oe_cmp_street = { oe_cmp_tgt_q = yes owner ?= scope:oe_cmp_seller }
                }
                scope:oe_cmp_street = { oe_col_post_fortify = yes }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_cmp_req_kind ?= 2 }
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_pay value = var:oe_cmp_req_paid }
                }
                else = {
                    save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_pay value = oe_cmp_req_half }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = scope:oe_cmp_pay }
                }
                scope:oe_cmp_seller = { add_gold = scope:oe_cmp_pay }
                if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_cmp_req_grant ?= 1 }
                    set_variable = oe_cmp_grant_kaffa
                    if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN }
                        c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_cmp_op_grant_gen target = c:BYZ } }
                    }
                }
                else_if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_cmp_req_grant ?= 2 }
                    set_variable = oe_cmp_grant_trebizond
                    scope:oe_cmp_seller = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_cmp_op_grant_tre target = c:BYZ } }
                }
                if = {
                    limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_qtr_n } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_qtr_n value = 0 }
                }
                change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_qtr_n add = 1 }
            }
            else = {
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 15 }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_paid }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = var:oe_cmp_req_paid }
                }
            }
            oe_cmp_req_clear = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 13 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_req_paid }
                change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund add = oe_cmp_req_half }
            }
            var:oe_cmp_req_who ?= {
                if = { limit = { is_ai = yes } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_no_cd years = 2 } }
                else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_no_cd years = 5 } }
            }
            if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_ans ?= 6 } set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 14 } }
            oe_cmp_req_clear = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 14 }
            var:oe_cmp_req_who ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_who }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_now value = oe_ml_month_now }
            save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_pay value = oe_cmp_prot_fee }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    exists = scope:oe_cmp_who
                    scope:oe_cmp_who = { oe_cmp_prot_new = yes }
                    has_variable = oe_cmp_fund
                    var:oe_cmp_fund >= scope:oe_cmp_pay
                }
                scope:oe_cmp_who = {
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_prot value = scope:oe_cmp_now }
                    add_opinion = { modifier = oe_cmp_op_protected target = c:BYZ }
                    add_gold = scope:oe_cmp_pay
                }
                change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = scope:oe_cmp_pay }
                oe_cmp_prot_count = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 15 } }
            oe_cmp_req_clear = yes
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 15 }
            add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_cmp_own_convoys years = 10 mode = replace }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 16 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_cmp_partner ?= 1 country_exists = c:GEN }
                c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_cmp_op_convoy target = c:BYZ } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:VEN }
                c:VEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_cmp_op_convoy target = c:BYZ } }
            }
            else_if = {
                limit = { country_exists = c:GEN }
                c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_cmp_op_convoy target = c:BYZ } }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 17 }
            var:oe_cmp_pick_loc ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_land }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    exists = scope:oe_cmp_land
                    scope:oe_cmp_land = { oe_cmp_tgt_ok = yes }
                    oe_cmp_can_buy = yes
                }
                oe_cmp_ask_buy = yes
            }
            remove_variable = oe_cmp_pick_loc
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 18 }
            var:oe_cmp_pick_who ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_who }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    exists = scope:oe_cmp_who
                    scope:oe_cmp_who = { oe_cmp_prot_new = yes }
                    oe_cmp_can_protect = yes
                }
                oe_cmp_ask_prot = yes
            }
            remove_variable = oe_cmp_pick_who
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 21 }
            var:oe_cmp_trib_who ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_who }
            if = { limit = { exists = scope:oe_cmp_who } oe_cmp_make_tributary = yes }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_trib_who } remove_variable = oe_cmp_trib_who }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 22 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end } }
                oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = 5 }
                oe_cmp_share_add = { n = -5 }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 23 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end } }
                international_organization:oe_byz_empire_pillars = {
                    change_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority add = -3 }
                    clamp_variable = { name = oe_pillars_authority min = 0 max = 100 }
                }
                oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = -20 }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 24 }
            if = {
                limit = { has_variable = oe_cmp_fund var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_cmp_e20c_fund }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_amt value = oe_cmp_e20c_fund }
                change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = scope:oe_cmp_amt }
                add_gold = oe_cmp_e20c_gold
                oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = -10 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 22 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 25 }
            location:chios = { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_land owner ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_seller } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    exists = scope:oe_cmp_seller
                    scope:oe_cmp_land = { oe_cmp_chios_fit = yes }
                    has_variable = oe_cmp_fund
                    var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_cmp_chios_price
                }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_pay value = oe_cmp_chios_price }
                oe_cmp_take_land = yes
                if = {
                    limit = { var:oe_cmp_took ?= 1 }
                    change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = scope:oe_cmp_pay }
                    scope:oe_cmp_seller = {
                        add_gold = scope:oe_cmp_pay
                        add_opinion = { modifier = oe_cmp_op_chios target = c:BYZ }
                    }
                    if = {
                        limit = { country_exists = c:GEN scope:oe_cmp_seller = { NOT = { this = c:GEN } } }
                        c:GEN = { add_opinion = { modifier = oe_cmp_op_chios target = c:BYZ } }
                    }
                    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_on } oe_itp_shift = { r = gen n = 1 } }
                    oe_cmp_truce = { who = scope:oe_cmp_seller years = 5 }
                    scope:oe_cmp_land = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_bought value = oe_ml_month_now } }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_chios value = 1 }
                    set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_last_seller value = scope:oe_cmp_seller }
                    scope:oe_cmp_land = { save_scope_as = oe_col_land }
                    if = {
                        limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_col_fc_due } }
                        set_variable = { name = oe_col_from_company value = 1 }
                    }
                    oe_col_found_colonia = yes
                    oe_cmp_count_land = yes
                }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 21 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 26 }
            location:chios = { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_land owner ?= { save_scope_as = oe_cmp_seller } }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    exists = scope:oe_cmp_seller
                    scope:oe_cmp_land = { oe_cmp_chios_fit = yes }
                    has_variable = oe_cmp_fund
                    var:oe_cmp_fund >= oe_cmp_chios_trib_price
                }
                save_scope_value_as = { name = oe_cmp_pay value = oe_cmp_chios_trib_price }
                change_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fund subtract = scope:oe_cmp_pay }
                scope:oe_cmp_seller = { add_gold = scope:oe_cmp_pay }
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_chios_trib years = 20 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_chios value = 2 }
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 21 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 27 }
            if = {
                limit = {
                    has_variable = oe_cmp_holder
                    var:oe_cmp_holder >= 2
                    NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end }
                    gold >= oe_cmp_nat_cost
                }
                oe_cmp_do_nat = yes
            }
            else = { set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_fail value = 23 } }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 28 }
            if = {
                limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end } }
                oe_cmp_share_add = { n = -10 }
                oe_cmp_auto_add = { n = -30 }
            }
        }
        else_if = {
            limit = { var:oe_cmp_job ?= 29 }
            if = {
                limit = { var:oe_cmp_holder ?= 3 NOT = { has_variable = oe_cmp_end } }
                if = {
                    limit = { has_variable = oe_itp_on }
                    if = { limit = { var:oe_cmp_partner ?= 1 } oe_itp_shift = { r = gen n = 1 } }
                    else = { oe_itp_shift = { r = ven n = 1 } }
                }
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_share value = 20 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_share_max value = 20 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_end value = 2 }
                set_variable = { name = oe_cmp_end_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
            }
        }
        remove_variable = oe_cmp_job
    }
}
